text:
The story began in 2019 year. Our client from Melitopol asked KAVOON Custom bike equipment Shop to sew a large kit of bags for him: a bumbag, a framebag and 2 "Tube" fork bags made in Ukrainian national blue-yellow colours. 

In February 2022 Melitopol was occupied by Russia. In order not to be exposed to danger, the client destroyed the bags of their Ukrainian patriotic look. 

A few weeks ago, we received the news that he had only recently managed to get out from the occupation, and ordered another the same kit in the same colours again.

We sincerely hope for the early victory and de-occupation of all our territory!
